 ORDER

PER: S.P. SOOD, JUDICIAL MEMBER:-
Delay of 77 days in filing of present appeal stands condoned for the reasons

mentioned in application seeking condonation of delay.
2. In present appeal No.123 of 2019; legality of order dated 05.10.2018 passed

by learned District Consumer Disputes Redressal Forum, Jhajjar (In short "District

Consumer Commission") in complaint case No.266 of 2017 has been assailed; vide

which complainant's complaint has been allowed.
3. Brief facts of the case are that complainant booked a room online in Hotel

Tiger Camp Resort Dhikuli, Ramnagar through OP from 24.03.2017 to 27.03.2017

and made the payment of Rs.15,949/- to OP on 03.03.2017. Complainant got
 cancelled the said booking from OP after 20 minutes on the same day and

confirmation having refund of booking amount through message dated 03.03.2017

was given by OP. When complainant noticed that no refund was credited to her

bank account, she complained the matter to OP. OP is not doing the needful and

lingering the matter on one pretext or the other. There is deficiency in service on the

part of OP.
4. Upon notice, OP raised its contest and submitted that complainant had booked

hotel vide booking ID No. HTLXY5JTZL after paying Rs.15,949/- to OP and that

booking was also got cancelled just after 20 minutes by complainant. OP has

refunded the amount through its banker HDFC bank and thereafter, it is the duty of

the bank to transfer the funds to the concerned bank account of complainant i.e.

Andhara Bank. Complainant has failed to explain as to how the OP was negligent in

providing service. OP is not liable to make any compensation to complainant.
5. Parties led their respective evidence. On analyzing the same; learned District

Consumer Commission, Jhajjar has allowed complaint vide impugned order dated

05.10.2018 and directed OP to pay Rs.15,949/- to complainant along with interest

@ 9% p.a. from the date of cancellation of booking i.e. 03.03.2017 till realization of

payment. Rs.3,300/- has also been awarded to complainant on account of mental

agony, harassment and litigation expenses.
6. Feeling aggrieved; OP has filed this appeal.
7. We have heard learned counsel for the appellant at length. With his able

assistance; record too has been perused. None has appeared on behalf of

respondent/complainant.
8. Learned counsel for appellant has urged that there is no deficiency on the part

of appellant because after receiving the request for cancellation of booking from the

complainant, appellant immediately refunded the amount through its banker-HDFC

Bank. It was the duty of the bank to transfer the funds to the concerned bank of

complainant i.e. Andhra Bank.
9. Admittedly, respondent/complainant booked room online through appellant

and also paid Rs.15,949/- to the appellant on 03.03.2017. Admittedly, complainant

got cancelled the said booking on the same day. Appellant through e-massage

dated 03.03.2017 had confirmed the refund of Rs.19,415/- to complainant. A perusal

of statement of complainant's account of Andhra Bank reflects that amount has not

been refunded. Appellant failed to produce any evidence to prove that the booking

amount has been credited back to the account of the complainant. In wake of above

discussions, this Commission has arrived at an inescapable conclusion that no

fallacy, legal or factual has been committed by the learned District Consumer

Commission while passing impugned order dated 05.10.2018. Order dated

05.10.2018 passed by learned District Consumer Commission is maintained and

upheld. Present appeal is hereby dismissed being devoid of merit.
10. Statutory amount of Rs.7,500/- deposited by appellant at the time of filing of

this appeal be disbursed to respondent, after due identification and verification as

per rules.
11. Application(s) pending, if any stand disposed of in terms of the aforesaid

judgment.
12. A copy of this judgment be provided to the parties free of cost as mandated by
 the
Consumer Protection Act, 1986
/2019. The Judgment be uploaded forthwith on

the website of the Commission for the perusal of the parties.
13. File be consigned to record room.
